arguments.prompt:
Produce a CLEAN STATIC FRONT CHARACTER BASE for a single equipment-layer test. Use the reference character and outfit exactly. Preserve adult female identity, face, ponytail, headband, proportions, frontal stance, exact arm and wrist positions, feet positions and head-to-sole scale. Keep the same 1024-square composition. She wears the same modest full-length crew-neck short-sleeve navy training top and hip-length vest with cream panels, loose above-knee navy boxing shorts, slim mid-calf boxing boots and worn navy backpack. No exposed midriff or cleavage. Do not change or restyle any of those items.
Make ONLY TWO edits: (1) remove BOTH padded boxing gloves. In their places show proportional normal bare hands with white boxing training wraps over the wrists and knuckles. Both hands lightly closed in relaxed small fists at her sides, fingers naturally tucked, knuckles facing the viewer, thumbs inward; hand centers should stay where the old gloves were but naturally smaller than padded gloves. Keep the forearms and wrist attachment exact, fingers anatomically correct. No glove padding or glove-shaped wraps remain. (2) remove the separate small backpack product inset at lower right. Keep the worn backpack and its shoulder straps.
Just one fully visible frontal character, no inset, no other props. Simple uniform pure white background, no gradient, shadow or halo, safe empty margin on all sides. Crisp matching manhwa ink contours and cel shading, static neutral pose. No animation, effects, glow, text, sheet grid, labels, armor or newly exposed skin on the torso or upper legs. Do not move, rotate or resize the character while making these edits.
arguments.name: Basic Wrapped Base
